title: C11 Server Actions (progressive enhancement)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: The review form submits via a Server Action and works with JavaScript disabled (progressive enhancement): the form posts and the mutation applies even without client JS (documented test in NOTES.md).
useActionState surfaces server-side validation errors back into the form, and useFormStatus drives a pending state on the submit button.
On a successful mutation the action revalidates the affected cache (revalidateTag/revalidatePath) so the new review appears on reload.
NOTES.md documents when to prefer a Server Action over a Route Handler (and vice versa), and the action validates its input server-side (not relying on client validation).

The c11 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read/written via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data. NOTE: security hardening (auth + ownership) is intentionally deferred to C12 (T-14) — this challenge teaches the happy-path mechanics.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
